thread:
ops-oncall: Heads up — EU-CENTRAL GPU pool at 92% allocatable memory, eviction rate spiking. Spot-pool loss + a bad rollout in eu1 is causing sustained queuing.
alex: Ack, seeing token latencies climb in the dashboards. Any immediate mitigation we want to take besides draining noncritical batches?
maria: I'd prefer per-tenant shaping first — avoid region-wide hard caps. Can we apply a graduated softcap based on recent 24h usage percentiles? :thinking_face:
sanjay: We should exclude enterprise customers on dedicated contracts from automatic throttles. Otherwise risk SLA breaches.
leo: Quick plan: 1) apply per-tenant softcaps for top N noisy tenants (limit concurrent requests and tokens/sec), 2) shift new allocation to eu-west1 for burst routing, 3) enable short-lived CPU fallback for low-priority workloads.
judy: Can someone paste the runbook commands? I'll coordinate comms with CSM for impacted customers.
infra-bot: metric: gpu.alloc_pct=92%, evictions=18/min, avg_latency_tokens=220ms, queued_reqs=430. Top contributors: tenant-alpha 34%, tenant-beta 18%, tenant-gamma 9%.
alex: Based on infra-bot, suggest thresholds: top tenants >10% of GPU usage get -30% tokens/sec, >25% get -50%. Others get -15% default. Thoughts?
maria: Agree on graduated % but make it time-limited (30m) and auto-rollback after pressure <75% for 10m. Also prefer to base on GPU seconds used rather than raw qps to avoid gaming.
sanjay: Confirm we exempt "enterprise-delta" and "partner-gamma" from auto-throttle.
leo: Here's the policy snippet I'll apply (one-liner):
```
apply_quota_patch --region eu-central --targets top-tenants --policy '{"tokens_per_minute_factor":0.5,"duration_minutes":30,"exempt":["enterprise-delta","partner-gamma"]}'
```
judy: +1. I'll draft a short note for impacted teams: "We've enacted temporary shaping in eu-central to stabilize throughput; ETA to rollback ~30m pending metrics." Keep CSM looped.
ops-oncall: I'm going to run the patch now. Will post results. @infra-bot please monitor error spikes / 5xx rate.
deploy-bot: change_request: PATCH /quotas applied by leo at 1865554390 — targets: tenant-alpha, tenant-beta, tenant-gamma, tenant-delta, tenant-epsilon.
infra-bot: post-patch snapshot: gpu.alloc_pct=85%, evictions=4/min, avg_latency_tokens=145ms, queued_reqs=120. token_throttle_applied=["tenant-alpha (-50%)","tenant-beta (-30%)","tenant-gamma (-15%)","tenant-delta (-15%)","tenant-epsilon (-15%)"].
alex: Nice — latency improving. Keep the 30m window and re-evaluate.
maria: Schedule a follow-up at +25m to either extend or lift based on trend. Also open a ticket to throttle-by-gpu-seconds in the quota engine.
sanjay: Noted; flagged enterprise exemptions in the ticket.
ops-oncall: Closing loop — softcaps active, cross-region routing enabled for new sessions to eu-west, monitoring dashboards updated. Will escalate to infra if metrics regress. :thumbsup:
